summary.text: Greg Taylor is a Democratic member of the Indiana Senate for District 33, which includes parts of Indianapolis.
The caucus page describes him as the first African American leader of an Indiana legislative caucus.

paragraphs.text: Taylor holds a Juris Doctor from the Indiana University Law School, and the page lists Taylor as special counsel at MWH Law Group.

The page lists a 2011 Indiana Addiction Recovery Legislative Advocate Award and a 2009 Indiana Minority Health Coalition Award, and says he lives in Indianapolis with his wife, Danielle, and has three children.
